# The Core Standard

> The Core Standard is a scenario-based executive assistant assessment, built and reviewed in the UK by specialist EA recruiters. Employers commission it to see how a candidate performs in a realistic EA working day before they hire. EAs can sit the same assessment themselves through TCS Certified and own the result. Every assessment is scored against five pillars (Prioritisation, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Partnership) on a published, behaviourally anchored rubric, and reviewed by a specialist. Reports are returned within 48 hours.

Trading name of eavolve Ltd. Founders: Lily Shippen (specialist EA and PA recruiter, founder of Lily Shippen Recruitment and eavolve) and Emily Partridge (former C-suite Executive Assistant). Pricing is in pounds sterling; the business serves employers across the UK.

Three employer levels: Operational EA (£495 +VAT), EA to Senior Leadership (£695 +VAT), Executive Business Partner (£995 +VAT). Candidate certification, TCS Certified, is £175 inc. VAT. Chief of Staff is a separate stream, in development. It is not a typing test, a multiple-choice quiz or a psychometric.
